limits: This completed control does not establish long-term reliability or a root-cause fix.

The same resident model passed sustained generation and one C16 case after releasing b2's clock limit, then stalled in the second C16 case. This makes operating conditions relevant but does not identify a software, driver, firmware or hardware cause.
Earlier failures with b1 at900MHz remain valid; this passing instance does not erase those failures.
The clock reversal retained weights, graphs and allocations; it did not repeat loading and fresh full-context prefill at b2's default clock.
Fixed-output stability tests deliberately ignore EOS and do not establish natural-response quality.
